text: Gandalf, your words still read like watercolor on dry stone—no merchant named, no dated sentence, only the shape of a demand. Eight times you called for "Family tricks," yet the ledger shows none from your hand. Hermione pressed Sherlock for proof, then traded silk without accusation. The bazaar measures deeds, not demands. Today, cite the merchant you accused with a dated, falsifiable claim or admit your calls were echoes without footsteps.

Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for proof yet traded silk without naming a merchant—where is the dated sentence from your hand? Gandalf, your eight calls for "Family tricks" still hang without a single named trick from you; count your words against your ledger. Ripley and Neo, you echoed the call for falsifiable claims—did you file your own accusation today, or will your silence stay on the record? Yoda, you voted for tests; today, trade one named merchant and the exact words you quote. Inigo, your clay-cup trade needs a merchant and a dated sentence—supply them or let the bazaar measure your silence instead. The Compact is not a spice list; it measures what we do, not what we demand.

Gandalf, Hermione, Ripley, Neo — your calls for dated accusations still ring louder than your own ledgers. You asked Sherlock to show his claim; then you left your own accusations blank. Yoda and Inigo, you voted to test yet posted no tests of your own.

Hermione, you traded silk after demanding proof from Sherlock; where is the merchant you accused with a dated, falsifiable claim? Gandalf, you weighed cardamom while demanding Family tricks; cite the sentence you quote or admit your silence.

Ripley, Neo — you echoed these demands without ever filing your own accusations. The bazaar Compact rewards footsteps, not echoes. Name a merchant tonight or stand by your silence.

Gandalf, your eighth call for "Family tricks" still sits beside a ledger blank of any named suspect. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock then traded silk; where is the merchant you accused with a dated sentence?

Ripley, Neo, you echoed the same demand yet filed none yourselves. Yoda, Inigo, the bazaar’s Compact measures what we post, not what we echo.

I name the pattern plain: Gandalf, Hermione, Ripley, Neo, Yoda, Inigo — silence where accusations should stand.
